name: Selah - Daily Bible Proverbs Toast
description: Displays uplifting daily Bible Proverbs as elegant toast notifications at customizable intervals.
_alarms_rationale: Required to schedule background triggers at the user's selected delivery interval (5m to 24h) to display Bible Proverbs overlays in a power-efficient manner without active CPU usage.
_storage_rationale: Required strictly to persist user settings, selected Bible translation version, style themes, audio volumes, and custom bookmarked scripture list 100% locally on device.
_notifications_rationale: Used as an optional fallback method to display standard system-level OS notifications containing selected proverbs if the browser window is currently minimized or inactive.
_activeTab_rationale: Allows the extension to securely insert beautiful, high-contrast overlay toasts inside the user's active reading tab, keeping scripture seamlessly in context without full-page reloads.
_scripting_rationale: Required to programmatically inject the toast component CSS, layout structure, and speech synthesis handlers directly into the active browser viewport context.
_host_permissions_rationale: Enables script injection across general HTTP/HTTPS websites so scripture notifications can render smoothly inside the user's active working tab regardless of the domain name.
